verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: T. H.*
verse_text_arabic: طه
verse_text_transliterated: tta-ha
verse_footnote_english: *20:1 The role of these Quranic initials as components of the Quran's awesome mathematical miracle is given in detail in Appendix 1.
verse_text_arabic_clean: طه

verse_text_english: We did not reveal the Quran to you, to cause you any hardship.
verse_text_arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna litashq
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما أنزلنا عليك القرءان لتشقى

verse_text_english: Only to remind the reverent.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: illā tadhkiratan liman yakhsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا تذكرة لمن يخشى

verse_text_english: A revelation from the One who created the earth, and the high heavens.
verse_text_arabic: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verse_text_transliterated: tanzīlan mimman khalaqa l-arḍa wal-samāwāti l-ʿul
verse_text_arabic_clean: تنزيلا ممن خلق الأرض والسموت العلى

verse_text_english: God most gracious; He has assumed all authority. 6.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: al-raḥmānu ʿalā l-ʿarshi is'taw
verse_text_arabic_clean: الرحمن على العرش استوى

verse_text_english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens, and the earth, and everything between them, and everything beneath the ground.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wamā baynahumā wamā taḥta l-thar
verse_text_arabic_clean: له ما فى السموت وما فى الأرض وما بينهما وما تحت الثرى

verse_text_english: Whether you declare your convictions (or not) He knows the secret, and what is even more hidden.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu yaʿlamu l-sira wa-akhf
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن تجهر بالقول فإنه يعلم السر وأخفى

verse_text_english: GOD: there is no other god besides Him. To Him belong the most beautiful names.
verse_text_arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'n
verse_text_arabic_clean: الله لا إله إلا هو له الأسماء الحسنى

verse_text_english: Has the history of Moses come to you?
verse_text_arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wahal atāka ḥadīthu mūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهل أتىك حديث موسى

verse_text_english: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Wait here; I have seen a fire.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًى
verse_text_transliterated: idh raā nāran faqāla li-ahlihi um'kuthū innī ānastu nāran laʿallī ātīkum min'hā biqabasin aw ajidu ʿalā l-nāri huda
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ رءا نارا فقال لأهله امكثوا إنى ءانست نارا لعلى ءاتيكم منها بقبس أو أجد على النار هدى

verse_text_english: When he came to it, he was called, "O, Moses.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā atāhā nūdiya yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما أتىها نودى يموسى

verse_text_english: “I am your Lord, so take off your shoes.
verse_text_arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verse_text_transliterated: innī anā rabbuka fa-ikh'laʿ naʿlayka innaka bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwa
verse_footnote_english: 20:12. angels are not inuolved. and given credit for their participation.
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنى أنا ربك فاخلع نعليك إنك بالواد المقدس طوى

verse_text_english: “And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-anā ikh'tartuka fa-is'tamiʿ limā yūḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنا اخترتك فاستمع لما يوحى

verse_text_english: “I am the one God; there is no god except Me.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verse_text_transliterated: innanī anā l-lahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'bud'nī wa-aqimi l-ṣalata lidhik'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: إننى أنا الله لا إله إلا أنا فاعبدنى وأقم الصلوة لذكرى

verse_text_english: “The hour is sure to come; 1 keep it almost hidden, to repay each soul for whatever it did.*
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-sāʿata ātiyatun akādu ukh'fīhā lituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā tasʿ
verse_subtitle_english: End of the World is Not Hidden*
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الساعة ءاتية أكاد أخفيها لتجزى كل نفس بما تسعى

verse_text_english: “So, do not be distracted therefrom by those who disbelieve therein and follow their own opinions, lest you perish.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: falā yaṣuddannaka ʿanhā man lā yu'minu bihā wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu fatard
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا يصدنك عنها من لا يؤمن بها واتبع هوىه فتردى

verse_text_english: “And what is that in your right hand, Moses?”
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā til'ka biyamīnika yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما تلك بيمينك يموسى

verse_text_english: He said, "This is my staff. I lean on it, herd my sheep with it, and I use it for other purposes."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla hiya ʿaṣāya atawakka-u ʿalayhā wa-ahushu bihā ʿalā ghanamī waliya fīhā maāribu ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال هى عصاى أتوكؤا عليها وأهش بها على غنمى ولى فيها مـٔارب أخرى

verse_text_english: He said, "Throw it down, Moses."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla alqihā yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال ألقها يموسى

verse_text_english: He threw it down, and it turned into a live serpent. 21.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-alqāhā fa-idhā hiya ḥayyatun tasʿ
verse_text_arabic_clean: فألقىها فإذا هى حية تسعى

verse_text_english: He said, "Pick it up; do not be afraid. We will return it to its original state.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla khudh'hā walā takhaf sanuʿīduhā sīratahā l-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال خذها ولا تخف سنعيدها سيرتها الأولى

verse_text_english: “And put your hand under your wing, and it will come out white without a blemish; another miracle.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-uḍ'mum yadaka ilā janāḥika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin āyatan ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: واضمم يدك إلى جناحك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء ءاية أخرى

verse_text_english: “We will give you some of our great revelations.
verse_text_arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verse_text_transliterated: linuriyaka min āyātinā l-kub'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: لنريك من ءايتنا الكبرى

verse_text_english: “Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed.” 25.
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, cool my temper.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi ish'raḥ lī ṣadr
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب اشرح لى صدرى

verse_text_english: “And make this matter easy for me,
verse_text_arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: wayassir lī amr
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويسر لى أمرى

verse_text_english: “And untie a knot in my tongue,
verse_text_arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-uḥ'lul ʿuq'datan min lisān
verse_text_arabic_clean: واحلل عقدة من لسانى

verse_text_english: “To let them understand my speech.
verse_text_arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verse_text_transliterated: yafqahū qawl
verse_text_arabic_clean: يفقهوا قولى

verse_text_english: “And appoint an assistant for me from my family,
verse_text_arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ij'ʿal lī wazīran min ahl
verse_text_arabic_clean: واجعل لى وزيرا من أهلى

verse_text_english: “Aaron my brother.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
verse_text_transliterated: hārūna akh
verse_text_arabic_clean: هرون أخى

verse_text_english: “Strengthen my mission with him, 32.
verse_text_arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: ush'dud bihi azr
verse_text_arabic_clean: اشدد به أزرى

verse_text_english: "Let him be my partner in this matter.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ashrik'hu fī amr
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأشركه فى أمرى

verse_text_english: “That we may glorify You frequently,
verse_text_arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: kay nusabbiḥaka kathīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: كى نسبحك كثيرا

verse_text_english: “And commemorate You frequently.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wanadhkuraka kathīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونذكرك كثيرا

verse_text_english: “Surely, You are seer of us.”
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: innaka kunta binā baṣīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنك كنت بنا بصيرا

verse_text_english: He said, “You are granted your request, Moses.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla qad ūtīta su'laka yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال قد أوتيت سؤلك يموسى

verse_text_english: “And we have bestowed other blessings upon you before,
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad manannā ʿalayka marratan ukh'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد مننا عليك مرة أخرى

verse_text_english: “When we inspired your mother certain inspirations.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: idh awḥaynā ilā ummika mā yūḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ أوحينا إلى أمك ما يوحى

verse_text_english: “That: ‘You shall throw him into the box, then throw him into the river, and the river will cast him to the bank.
verse_text_arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُۥ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verse_text_transliterated: ani iq'dhifīhi fī l-tābūti fa-iq'dhifīhi fī l-yami falyul'qihi l-yamu bil-sāḥili yakhudh'hu ʿaduwwun lī waʿaduwwun lahu wa-alqaytu ʿalayka maḥabbatan minnī walituṣ'naʿa ʿalā ʿayn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أن اقذفيه فى التابوت فاقذفيه فى اليم فليلقه اليم بالساحل يأخذه عدو لى وعدو له وألقيت عليك محبة منى ولتصنع على عينى

verse_text_english: “Your sister then followed you, and said, ‘Let me tell you about one who can nurse him.’ We thus returned you to your mother, in order to keep her happy, and to remove her worries.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًا فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh tamshī ukh'tuka fataqūlu hal adullukum ʿalā man yakfuluhu farajaʿnāka ilā ummika kay taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynāka mina l-ghami wafatannāka futūnan falabith'ta sinīna fī ahli madyana thumma ji'ta ʿalā qadarin yāmūs
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ تمشى أختك فتقول هل أدلكم على من يكفله فرجعنك إلى أمك كى تقر عينها ولا تحزن وقتلت نفسا فنجينك من الغم وفتنك فتونا فلبثت سنين فى أهل مدين ثم جئت على قدر يموسى

verse_text_english: “I have made you just for Me.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verse_text_transliterated: wa-iṣ'ṭanaʿtuka linafs
verse_text_arabic_clean: واصطنعتك لنفسى

verse_text_english: “Go, you and your brother, with My revelations to Pharaoh, and do not waver in commemorating Me.
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verse_text_transliterated: idh'hab anta wa-akhūka biāyātī walā taniyā fī dhik'r
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهب أنت وأخوك بـٔايتى ولا تنيا فى ذكرى

verse_text_english: “Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed.
verse_text_arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: idh'habā ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verse_text_arabic_clean: اذهبا إلى فرعون إنه طغى

verse_text_english: “Talk to him gently, that he may take heed, or become reverent.” 45.
verse_text_arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: faqūlā lahu qawlan layyinan laʿallahu yatadhakkaru aw yakhsh
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقولا له قولا لينا لعله يتذكر أو يخشى

verse_text_english: They said, "Our Lord, we fear lest he may attack us, or transgress."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qālā rabbanā innanā nakhāfu an yafruṭa ʿalaynā aw an yaṭgh

verse_text_english: He said, “Have no fear; I will be with you, listening and watching.

verse_text_arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَآ أَمْتًا
verse_text_transliterated: lā tarā fīhā ʿiwajan walā amta
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا ترى فيها عوجا ولا أمتا

verse_text_english: On that day, everyone will follow the caller, without the slightest deviation. All sounds will be hushed before the Most Gracious; you will hear nothing but whispers.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma-idhin yattabiʿūna l-dāʿiya lā ʿiwaja lahu wakhashaʿati l-aṣwātu lilrraḥmāni falā tasmaʿu illā hamsa
verse_text_arabic_clean: يومئذ يتبعون الداعى لا عوج له وخشعت الأصوات للرحمن فلا تسمع إلا همسا

verse_text_english: On that day, intercession will be useless, except for those permitted by the Most Gracious, and whose utterances conform to His will.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًا
verse_text_transliterated: yawma-idhin lā tanfaʿu l-shafāʿatu illā man adhina lahu l-raḥmānu waraḍiya lahu qawla
verse_text_arabic_clean: يومئذ لا تنفع الشفعة إلا من أذن له الرحمن ورضى له قولا

verse_text_english: He knows their past and their future, while none encompasses His knowledge.
verse_text_arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًا
verse_text_transliterated: yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bihi ʿil'ma
verse_text_arabic_clean: يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم ولا يحيطون به علما

verse_text_english: All faces will submit to the Living, the Eternal, and those who are burdened by their transgressions will fail.
verse_text_arabic: وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
verse_text_transliterated: waʿanati l-wujūhu lil'ḥayyi l-qayūmi waqad khāba man ḥamala ẓul'ma
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعنت الوجوه للحى القيوم وقد خاب من حمل ظلما

verse_text_english: As for those who worked righteousness, while believing, they will have no fear of injustice or adversity.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا
verse_text_transliterated: waman yaʿmal mina l-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā yakhāfu ẓul'man walā haḍma
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن يعمل من الصلحت وهو مؤمن فلا يخاف ظلما ولا هضما

verse_text_english: We thus revealed it, an Arabic Quran, and we cited in it all kinds of prophecies, that they may be saved, or it may cause them to take heed.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: wakadhālika anzalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan waṣarrafnā fīhi mina l-waʿīdi laʿallahum yattaqūna aw yuḥ'dithu lahum dhik'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكذلك أنزلنه قرءانا عربيا وصرفنا فيه من الوعيد لعلهم يتقون أو يحدث لهم ذكرا

verse_text_english: Most Exalted is GOD, the only true King. Do not rush into uttering the Quran before it is revealed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase my knowledge."
verse_text_arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
verse_text_transliterated: fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu walā taʿjal bil-qur'āni min qabli an yuq'ḍā ilayka waḥyuhu waqul rabbi zid'nī ʿil'ma
verse_text_arabic_clean: فتعلى الله الملك الحق ولا تعجل بالقرءان من قبل أن يقضى إليك وحيه وقل رب زدنى علما

verse_text_english: We tested Adam in the past, but he forgot, and we found him indecisive.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًا
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ʿahid'nā ilā ādama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu ʿazma
verse_subtitle_english: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand*
verse_footnote_english: *20:115 When Satan challenged God's absolute authority (38:69), you and I did not make a firm stand against Satan. God is giving us a chance, on this earth, to redeem ourselves by denouncing Satan and upholding God's absolute authority (Appendix 7).
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد عهدنا إلى ءادم من قبل فنسى ولم نجد له عزما

verse_text_english: Recall that we said to the angels, "Fall prostrate before Adam." They fell prostrate, except Satan; he refused.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idh qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa ab
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذ قلنا للملئكة اسجدوا لءادم فسجدوا إلا إبليس أبى

verse_text_english: We then said, "O Adam, this is an enemy of you and your wife. Do not let him evict you from Paradise, lest you become miserable.
verse_text_arabic: فَقُلْنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: faqul'nā yāādamu inna hādhā ʿaduwwun laka walizawjika falā yukh'rijannakumā mina l-janati fatashq
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقلنا يـٔادم إن هذا عدو لك ولزوجك فلا يخرجنكما من الجنة فتشقى

verse_text_english: “You are guaranteed that you do not hunger therein, nor go naked.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: inna laka allā tajūʿa fīhā walā taʿr
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن لك ألا تجوع فيها ولا تعرى

verse_text_english: “And that you do not thirst therein, nor suffer any heat.” 120.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-annaka lā taẓma-u fīhā walā taḍḥ
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأنك لا تظمؤا فيها ولا تضحى

verse_text_english: But the devil whispered to him, saying, "O Adam, let me show you the tree of eternity and unending kingship."
verse_text_arabic: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fawaswasa ilayhi l-shayṭānu qāla yāādamu hal adulluka ʿalā shajarati l-khul'di wamul'kin lā yabl
verse_text_arabic_clean: فوسوس إليه الشيطن قال يـٔادم هل أدلك على شجرة الخلد وملك لا يبلى

verse_text_english: They ate from it, whereupon their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Adam thus disobeyed his Lord, and fell.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-akalā min'hā fabadat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā min waraqi l-janati waʿaṣā ādamu rabbahu faghaw
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأكلا منها فبدت لهما سوءتهما وطفقا يخصفان عليهما من ورق الجنة وعصى ءادم ربه فغوى

verse_text_english: Then his Lord chose him; He redeemed and guided him.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fatāba ʿalayhi wahad
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم اجتبه ربه فتاب عليه وهدى

verse_text_english: God said, “Go down therefrom, all of you, as enemies of one another.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla ih'biṭā min'hā jamīʿan baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun fa-immā yatiyannakum minnī hudan famani ittabaʿa hudāya falā yaḍillu walā yashq
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال اهبطا منها جميعا بعضكم لبعض عدو فإما يأتينكم منى هدى فمن اتبع هداى فلا يضل ولا يشقى

verse_text_english: “As for him who disregards My message, he will have a miserable life, and we raise him, on the day of resurrection, blind." 125.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: waman aʿraḍa ʿan dhik'rī fa-inna lahu maʿīshatan ḍankan wanaḥshuruhu yawma l-qiyāmati aʿm
verse_subtitle_english: For the Disbelievers: Miserable Life Unavoidable
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن أعرض عن ذكرى فإن له معيشة ضنكا ونحشره يوم القيمة أعمى

verse_text_english: He will say, "My Lord, why did you summon me blind, when I used to be a seer?"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًا
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi lima ḥashartanī aʿmā waqad kuntu baṣīra
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب لم حشرتنى أعمى وقد كنت بصيرا

verse_text_english: He will say, "Because you forgot our revelations when they came to you, you are now forgotten."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla kadhālika atatka āyātunā fanasītahā wakadhālika l-yawma tuns
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال كذلك أتتك ءايتنا فنسيتها وكذلك اليوم تنسى

verse_text_english: We thus requite those who transgress and refuse to believe in the revelations of their Lord. The retribution in the Hereafter is far worse and everlasting.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verse_text_transliterated: wakadhālika najzī man asrafa walam yu'min biāyāti rabbihi walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati ashaddu wa-abq
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكذلك نجزى من أسرف ولم يؤمن بـٔايت ربه ولعذاب الءاخرة أشد وأبقى

verse_text_english: Does it ever occur to them how many previous generations we have annihilated? They are now walking in the homes of those before them. These are signs for those who possess intelligence.
verse_text_arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā qablahum mina l-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim inna fī dhālika laāyātin li-ulī l-nuh
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفلم يهد لهم كم أهلكنا قبلهم من القرون يمشون فى مسكنهم إن فى ذلك لءايت لأولى النهى

verse_text_english: If it were not for your Lord's predetermined plan, they would have been judged immediately.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى
verse_text_transliterated: walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakāna lizāman wa-ajalun musamma
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لكان لزاما وأجل مسمى

verse_text_english: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before sunset. And during the night glorify Him, as well as at both ends of the day, that you may be happy.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla ghurūbihā wamin ānāi al-layli fasabbiḥ wa-aṭrāfa l-nahāri laʿallaka tarḍ
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاصبر على ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل غروبها ومن ءانائ اليل فسبح وأطراف النهار لعلك ترضى

verse_text_english: And do not covet what we bestowed upon any other people. Such are temporary ornaments of this life, whereby we put them to the test. What your Lord provides for you is far better, and everlasting.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: walā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājan min'hum zahrata l-ḥayati l-dun'yā linaftinahum fīhi wariz'qu rabbika khayrun wa-abq
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا تمدن عينيك إلى ما متعنا به أزوجا منهم زهرة الحيوة الدنيا لنفتنهم فيه ورزق ربك خير وأبقى

verse_text_english: You shall enjoin your family to observe the contact prayers (Salat), and steadfastly persevere in doing so. We do not ask you for any provisions; we are the ones who provide for you. The ultimate triumph belongs to the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًا نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ وَٱلْعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: wamur ahlaka bil-ṣalati wa-iṣ'ṭabir ʿalayhā lā nasaluka riz'qan naḥnu narzuquka wal-ʿāqibatu lilttaqw
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأمر أهلك بالصلوة واصطبر عليها لا نسـٔلك رزقا نحن نرزقك والعقبة للتقوى

verse_text_english: They said, "If he could only show us a miracle from his Lord!" Did they not receive sufficient miracles with the previous messages?
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū lawlā yatīnā biāyatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu mā fī l-ṣuḥufi l-ūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا لولا يأتينا بـٔاية من ربه أولم تأتهم بينة ما فى الصحف الأولى

verse_text_english: Had we annihilated them before this, they would have said, "Our Lord, had You sent a messenger to us, we would have followed Your revelations, and would have avoided this shame and humiliation."
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: walaw annā ahlaknāhum biʿadhābin min qablihi laqālū rabbanā lawlā arsalta ilaynā rasūlan fanattabiʿa āyātika min qabli an nadhilla wanakhz
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو أنا أهلكنهم بعذاب من قبله لقالوا ربنا لولا أرسلت إلينا رسولا فنتبع ءايتك من قبل أن نذل ونخزى

verse_text_english: Say, "All of us are waiting, so wait; you will surely find out who are on the correct path, and who are truly guided."
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verse_text_transliterated: qul kullun mutarabbiṣun fatarabbaṣū fasataʿlamūna man aṣḥābu l-ṣirāṭi l-sawiyi wamani ih'tad
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل كل متربص فتربصوا فستعلمون من أصحب الصرط السوى ومن اهتدى
